title: Deterministic presentation table renderer v1
source_of_truth: tests/fixtures/artifacts/valid/ (existing synthetic artifact bundle; scientific numbers obtained from estimates.json, not hard-coded)
scope: estimate-table views sourced from estimates with explicit estimate_id references (fixed fields term/estimate/std_error/p_value/n). Validates ONLY the estimate-table renderer; does NOT cover generic tables, descriptive/diagnostic/model tables, or figures.
gate: full artifact-bundle validation (core validateArtifacts: scientific artifact structure + estimates<->model_registry + replication_stamp consistency + artifact_manifest canonical hashes + presentation provenance binding/source_hash)

cases.A: determinism (same artifacts + manifest, render twice -> identical bytes)
cases.B: source fidelity (rendered values equal the referenced values from estimates.json)
cases.C: upstream change propagation (modify copied estimates.json -> old presentation hash fails; refresh binding -> renders, output changes)
cases.D: manual rendered-output tampering (altered output differs from a fresh deterministic rerender)

no_op: does NOT promote any implementation to verified; tested promotion is handled separately and is NOT a consequence of this synthetic benchmark
